heading: ETFs vs. index funds
author: Venkatesh Bangaruswamy
paragraphs: Suppose you decide to invest in passive funds for your goal-based investments.

You must first select a benchmark index and then choose an exchange-traded fund (ETF) or an index fund on that benchmark index. In this article, we discuss the factors that you must consider when deciding between an ETF and an index fund.
